description: Daewoo Engineering & Construction said Thursday its CEO Lee Kang-seok met with Turkmen President Serdar Berdimuhamedov earlier this week as the Korean builder seeks to expand its business in the Central Asian country. description: GS Entec, a subsidiary of GS Global, will supply 37 monopiles for the 504-megawatt Taean offshore wind farm off the coast of Taean, South Chungcheong Province. Under a contract signed Wednesday at the Seoul headquarters of Taean Wind Power, GS Entec will begin production in July 2027 and complete deliveries by the end of August 2028. description: US President Donald Trump on Wednesday unveiled South Korea's US investment projects under last year's bilateral trade agreement: the construction of a gas-fired power plant in Texas, eight large-scale nuclear power plants and a liquefied natural gas project in Alaska. The announcement followed protracted negotiations over major energy infrastructure projects under the agreement that committed South Korea to investing $350 billion in the United States -- $150 billion for the shipbuilding sector
title: Trump unveils S. Korea's investment plans for Alaska LNG project, Texas power plant, 8 nuclear reactors

description: GENEVA (AFP) -- The Swiss Football Association, or SFV, announced Wednesday that it was withdrawing its support for incumbent Gianni Infantino in next year's FIFA presidential election. Several leading European national associations have pulled their support for Infantino after he caused uproar in July with proposals to create a commercial subsidiary to run FIFA's biggest events, such as the World Cup and Club World Cup.
